_notice: Fourteen labelled quote pairs. The labels are the ground truth for two metrics: which components the engine aligns, and whether it correctly refuses to attribute the price difference. The refusals are the harder half — a comparison engine that always produces a number scores zero on them.

expect.note: Disposal is ancillary. Two quotes that cover the same work and differ only in whether the skip is a separate line are two prices for the same job, and naming the disposal as the headline difference would bury the thing that matters.
